sloka: इदं शरीरं कृत्स्नस्य लोकस्य चरता हितम् ।पाण्दुरस्यातपत्रस्य च्छायायां जरितं मया ॥२-२-७॥
transliteration: idaṁ śarīraṁ kṛtsnasya lokasya caratā hitam ।pāṇdurasyātapatrasya cchāyāyāṁ jaritaṁ mayā ॥2-2-7॥

translations.english: My body has attained old age after ruling the entire world ensuring the welfare of the people under the shade of royal white parasol.
